A default route with the head office router as its next hop
A host route to the ISP router's IP address
A static route to each head office subnet

reference.title: Default Route and Routing Loop Issues
reference.find: default route can also be configured

questions.stem: After a front desk PC is moved to a different wall jack, it can no longer reach any of the office PCs on the same switch, although its cable tests good. Which of the following is the MOST likely cause?

choices.text: The PC's switch port is assigned to another VLAN
The PC has the wrong default gateway address
The switch's trunk link to the router is down
A routing loop has formed between two routers

reference.title: VLAN Assignment Issues
reference.find: Hosts in the VLAN must use

questions.stem: To put three lab PCs in the staff VLAN, a technician gives them static IP settings for the staff subnet, but they cannot ping the staff default gateway that other staff PCs use. Which of the following should the technician check FIRST?

choices.text: The VLAN assigned to the PCs' switch ports
The patch panel labels for the PCs' wall jacks
The DHCP relay setting for the staff VLAN
The default route on the staff VLAN's router

reference.title: VLAN Assignment Issues
reference.find: physically connected to the correct
